semanticChecks: Urine sequence kidney, ureter, bladder, urethra remains distinct from digestive tract, stool formation, rectum and anus. Urge awareness, organ function, finding toilet, movement, clothing and hygiene are separate abilities. Bladder500ml/urge200–300ml remain study examples, not safe-wait thresholds or universal values.

Urine1000–1500ml/4–6times, high2000–3000ml-plus, low300–500ml-or-less, daytime8/night2frequency examples and stool1–2times remain learning reference values requiring individual baseline, not care-worker diagnostic criteria.

Constipation includes hardness, difficulty, incomplete emptying and reduced usual output; functional/organic mechanisms are distinguished without diagnosis. Diarrhea retains dehydration, perianal irritation and medical-professional reporting for sudden onset. Water/fibre/activity/drinks remain state/plan/professional-bound, never universal changes.

Privacy is compatible with necessary reporting and safety: low voice, private place, necessary staff only; no public detail, blame or invented kinship. Actual toileting is not delayed for practice. Call button existence differs from function/reach/comprehension/use; outside waiting remains unconfirmed pending monitoring plan.

Left hemiplegia example retains unaffected hand on rail, support from affected side and individual/training conditions. Holding support to stand does not establish unsupported clothing ability. Stable sitting clothing work reduces standing burden; no pulling paretic arm or moving with garments entangled at feet. Forward-lean/raised-heel bowel posture is an example, not universal instruction.

Urinal, bedpan, portable toilet, diapers and pads retain different purposes/postural abilities and individual method requirements. Prepared equipment is not plan authorization; Kawase checks current plan and worker informs colleague. No forced insertion or hip lift, gender-only method choice, painful friction or untrained transfer. Removal alone does not complete aftercare.

Five urinary-incontinence mechanisms retain cough/abdominal-pressure, acute urge, retention/overflow, spinal-reflex regulation and environmental/movement/clothing/cognitive factors. Categories support observation, not independent diagnosis or equipment/drug changes. Generic失禁 remains urine-or-stool incontinence where Japanese does not narrow it.

Diaper changes preserve prior health/explanation/consent, clean/used separation, limited exposure, trained position changes, waterproofing, glove change and hand hygiene at dirty-to-clean transition. Female cleaning remains urethral/front to anal/back with clean surfaces, gentle folds and moisture removal. Male scrotal-under/surrounding cleaning stays trained/external; no guessed deep manipulation.

Body-temperature water and2–3finger looseness remain textbook examples qualified by sensation/skin/product/individual/facility instructions. Product/size/wrinkle/rolled-edge/pressure/skin/comfort/linen checks and clinical reporting preserved; no self-treatment or substitution of leak absence for full checks.
